Organic Peppermint Bark
By: Zomppa
Published: Sunday, December 27, 2009 - 8:48pm

Ingredients




8 ounces semi-sweet organic chocolate
6 crushed organic candy canes
1/2 bag (4 oz.) organic white chocolate chips

Preparation

1 Melt semi-sweet chocolate over double boiler 2 Spread thin on wax paper over a cookie sheet or Silpat 3 Chop candy canes in food processor and spread over warm chocolate 4 Let set in refrigerator 5 Melt white chocolate 6 Spread over hardened chocolate 7 Set in refrigerator 8 Break and enjoy!

About


Using candy canes made from cane sugar, such as Pure Fun Candy Canes make them delightfully sweet but not too sweet. Simple, easy present.
